domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping/borrowing and rewriting forms)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Determine a least common (or target) denominator and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that common denominator to enable subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Finds an LCD/LCM (or otherwise selects a target common denominator) for two different denominators
Converts one or more fractions to equivalent forms with the common denominator prior to subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only rewrites a whole number or mixed number form (e.g., mixed→improper, whole→fraction) without the key step being establishing a common denominator between two different denominators
Only simplifies/reduces a fraction (e.g., 4/10→2/5) without creating a common denominator for subtraction

skills.name: Subtract compatible quantities
skills.definition: Compute the difference once quantities are in compatible form (e.g., like denominators or aligned whole/fraction parts) by subtracting the appropriate parts and forming the resulting value.
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts fractions with like denominators by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator
Subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately (when already aligned) and obtains the difference (before any borrowing step)
Computes intermediate differences such as 0/b or a negative fractional difference as part of the subtraction process
exclusion_criteria: The main work is converting to a common denominator (tag S01)
The main work is rewriting number forms (mixed↔improper, whole→fraction/mixed) to set up subtraction (tag S03)
The key step is borrowing/regrouping from the whole part to fix a negative fractional part (tag S04)

skills.name: Rewrite mixed/whole forms
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers into an equivalent form that makes subtraction straightforward (e.g., mixed→improper, interpret nonstandard mixed numbers, or express a whole number with a chosen denominator/zero fractional part).
inclusion_criteria: Converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (or improper to mixed as part of expressing the result)
Interprets a nonstandard mixed number with an improper fractional part (e.g., 1 4/3) as an improper fraction
Rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator or as a mixed number with 0/n to align parts
exclusion_criteria: The key step is finding an LCD and converting two different denominators to that LCD (tag S01)
The key step is borrowing/regrouping (decreasing the whole part by 1 and adding d/d) to avoid a negative fractional subtraction (tag S04)
Only performs the subtraction once forms are already compatible (tag S02)

skills.name: Borrow/regroup in subtraction
skills.definition: When a mixed-number (or whole-minus-fraction) subtraction would produce a negative fractional part, borrow 1 from the whole part and add one whole (d/d) to the fractional part, then continue the subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Shows or anticipates a negative fractional difference and then borrows 1 from the whole part
Explicitly adds a full fraction (e.g., 5/5, 12/12, 24/24) after decreasing the whole part by 1
Recomputes the fractional subtraction after borrowing/regrouping
exclusion_criteria: No borrowing/regrouping is needed because the fractional part subtraction is already nonnegative
Only rewrites mixed/whole numbers without the borrow-and-add-d/d regrouping mechanism (tag S03)
Only simplifies/reduces the final fraction without any borrowing step
